During the early formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the '''son''' of a [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist|wealthy industrialist]]. As a result, the father arranged for a hit on Vader via nine [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], eight of whom were killed.

==History==
The son of a [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist|wealthy industrialist]] worked in his father's company. In order to force employees to work harder, he would whip them himself. When his father's company had to make concessions to a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]-based company, he did not like it. In an attempt to end the negotiations, he pulled out a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Nautolans, but [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who was overseeing the arrangements, used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to deflect the shot back at the son, killing him.

After his son's death, the industrialist hired nine [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to kill Vader.
